records.source: Press button for a more difficult journey...
records.translation: Pindutin ang button para sa mas mahirap na paglalakbay...
May butas ng susi na hugis-bungo...

records.source: There's a bunch of protein bar wrappers.
Looks like Sam cleans his trash bin regularly.
records.translation: Mukhang regular na nililinis ni Sam ang kaniyang basurahan.

records.source: It's full of clothes... wait. There's a sword hidden under the clothes.
records.translation: Puno ito ng damit... sandali. May espadang nakatago sa ilalim ng mga damit.

records.source: Captain: Ahoy there! Want to take the deep-sea fishing tour? It'll cost ya 1,000g.
records.translation: Kapitan: Ahoy! Gusto mo bang sumama sa paglilibot para mangisda sa malalim na dagat? Nagkakahalaga ito ng 1,000g.

records.source: Captain: Shall I take us back up?
records.translation: Kapitan: Iaahon ko na ba tayo?

records.source: Captain: We're back! Make sure not to leave any fish lying around.
records.translation: Kapitan: Nakabalik na tayo! Tiyaking walang maiiwang isda kung saan-saan.

records.source: It doesn't seem to be working...

Reset your progress in the mine?
(You'll be back at mine level 1).
records.translation:
I-reset ang pagsulong mo sa minahan?
(Babalik ka sa antas 1 ng minahan).

records.source: This table's for the big shots. It's a 1000 coin bet.
records.translation: Para sa mga bigating manlalaro ang mesang ito. 1000 barya ang taya.

records.source: Wanna play some CalicoJack? This is the 100 coin table.
records.translation: Gustong maglaro ng CalicoJack? Ito ang mesang may tayang 100 barya.

records.source: You have 0 Club Coins. Buy a starter pack for 1000g?
records.translation: Wala kang Barya ni Qi. Bumili ng panimulang pakete sa halagang 1000g?

records.source: Psst... I have a 'Statue of Endless Fortune' for sale... only 1,000,000g. What do you say?
records.translation: Psst... May ibinebenta akong 'Estatwa ng Walang-Hanggang Kapalaran'... 1,000,000g lamang. Ano sa palagay mo?

records.source: Hey, I said 1,000,000g! This isn't gonna cut it.
records.translation: Hoy, 1,000,000g ang sabi ko! Hindi ito sapat.

records.source:
You translate the dwarvish:

Stand between the pillars three
With gift as precious as the sky:
A rainbow forged from land, not sea
Then galaxies will heed your cry.
records.translation:
Isinasalin mo ang wikang Duwende:

Tumayo sa pagitan ng tatlong haligi
Taglay ang kaloob na singhalaga ng langit:
Bahagharing hinubog ng lupa, hindi dagat
At diringgin ng mga galaksi ang iyong sigaw.

records.source: Shadow Guy: Eeeeep! You caught me! I'm sorry! Take it! Take it! It looked so valuable, I couldn't help myself...
records.translation: Taong-Anino: Eeeeep! Nahuli mo ako! Patawad! Kunin mo! Kunin mo! Mukhang napakahalaga nito, hindi ko napigilan ang sarili ko...

records.source: Driver: Hey kid... I need a lucky break... why don't 'cha bring me a 'rabbit's foot'? I'll make it worth your while.
records.translation: Drayber: Hoy, bata... Kailangan ko ng suwerte... dalhan mo kaya ako ng 'paa ng kuneho'? Sulit ang ibabayad ko.

records.source: Driver: Come back when you got a 'rabbit's foot' on ya, kid.
records.translation: Drayber: Bumalik ka kapag may dala ka nang 'paa ng kuneho', bata.

records.source: It's locked... Only {0}'s friends can enter uninvited.
records.translation: Naka-lock ito... Tanging mga kaibigan ni {0} ang makapapasok nang hindi inaanyayahan.

records.source: What can I do for you?
records.translation: Ano ang maitutulong ko sa iyo?
Magtayo ng mga Gusali sa Bukid

records.source:
Sorry! Shop's closed for the day... I'm at Caroline's place for aerobics club.

-Robin
records.translation:
Paumanhin! Sarado ang tindahan ngayong araw... Nasa bahay ako ni Caroline para sa samahan ng aerobics.

-Robin
